blurb: Ice In Paradise provides public skating sessions for all ages and abilities, private rink rentals for events, youth hockey programs, and educational STEM field trips. The facility includes NHL regulation and junior ice rinks and offers affordable programs fostering community engagement. They also operate a Success Center with workstations and volunteer tutoring for skaters and their families.
